# Lospec

> > Lospec is a comprehensive resource hub for pixel artists featuring color palettes, tutorials, and tools for creating retro-style game art and sprites.

The site hosts an extensive palette library with popular collections like PICO-8 and CGArne, downloadable in formats for Photoshop, Aseprite, and other tools. Lospec also provides in-depth pixel art tutorials covering animation, color theory, tiling, and sprite creation techniques from artists like DawnBringer and the PixelJoint community.

## Key Topics

- Pixel art creation and techniques
- Color palettes and palette theory
- PICO-8 fantasy console
- Aseprite pixel art software
- Sprite animation and character design
- Game Boy and retro console aesthetics
- PixelJoint community and competitions
- Shading and color contrast
- Tile-based artwork
- DawnBringer palettes
- Artist palettes and color ramps
- 16-color and limited palette work
- Beginner pixel art guides
- Palette downloads for Photoshop and other tools

## Pixel Art Tutorials

- [Basics of Animation by Jason Perry](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/basics-of-animation-by-jason-perry): Jason Perry's basic introduction to pixel art animation principles
- [Full Circle Color Ramps by RHL Pixels](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/full-circle-color-ramps-by-rhl-pixels): RHL Pixels tutorial on creating palettes using color ramp methods
- [Attack Animation by Sandy Gordon](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/attack-animation-by-sandy-gordon): Sandy Gordon tutorial on creating attack animations for characters
- [Pixel Art Tutorial Series Part 4: Color Contrast by Solar Lune](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/pixel-art-tutorial-series-part-4-color-contrast-by-solar-lune): Solar Lune tutorial on color contrast in character sprites
- [How to Make Pixel Fonts Tutorial by Sam Keddy](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/how-to-make-pixel-fonts-tutorial-by-sam-keddy): Sam Keddy tutorial on creating pixel art fonts and software tools
- [Les Forges Pixel Art Course Chapter 8: A World of Tiles by Antoine Gersant](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/les-forges-pixel-art-course-chapter-8-a-world-of-tiles-by-antoine-gersant): Antoine Gersant's Les Forges course chapter on tile creation techniques
- [How to Pixel Art Tutorial Part 8: Background by Christopher Yabsley](https://lospec.com/pixel-art-tutorials/how-to-pixel-art-tutorial-part-8-background-by-christopher-yabsley): Christopher Yabsley walkthrough for Sword & Sorcery backgrounds

## Featured Color Palettes

- [PICO-8 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/pico-8): Official 16-color palette from Lexaloffle's PICO-8 fantasy console
- [CGArne Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/cgarne): Arne Niklas Jansson's 16-color retro Windows 3.1-inspired palette
- [Generic 15 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/generic-15): GrafxKid's Generic 15 color palette with multiple download formats
- [Andrew Kensler 54 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/andrew-kensler-54): Andrew Kensler's 54-color calculated NES palette algorithm
- [Mist GB Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/mist-gb): Kerrie Lake's 4-color Game Boy retro palette Mist GB
- [Starmancer Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/starmancer): 52-color palette from Starmancer Kickstarter game
- [Tūī 15 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/tui-15): Jeremy's Tūī 15 palette from PixelJoint competition with downloads

## Artist and Competition Palettes

- [Nevercreature 11 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/nevercreature-11): Nevercreature's 11-color PixelJoint competition palette
- [Daruda 22 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/daruda-22): Daruda's 22-color PixelJoint competition entry palette
- [Goblin18 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/goblin18): IdleTrashCan's 18-color Goblin18 artist palette with downloads
- [MarshMellow32 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/marshmellow32): FormalPrejudice's 32-color linear MarshMellow32 palette
- [Calder 8 Palette](https://lospec.com/palette-list/calder-8): Alexander Calder-inspired 11-color palette by Philip Dodderidge
